mapper.select: SELECT r.*, m.name AS owner_name FROM pm_risk r LEFT JOIN pm_member m ON r.owner_id = m.id WHERE r.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY (CASE r.level WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END), r.identified_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pm_risk (project_id, title, category, probability, impact, level, status, mitigation, owner_id, identified_date, resolved_date) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{title}, #{category}, #{probability}, #{impact}, #{level}, #{status}, #{mitigation}, #{ownerId}, #{identifiedDate}, #{resolvedDate})
